qualification.details: Eligibility: Officers under the Central/State Governments/Union Territories Administration holding analogous posts. Deputation Period: Ordinarily not exceeding three years. Pay Scale: Pay Matrix Level-11 | Age Limit: Not exceeding 45 years Essential Qualification: Master's degree in Occupational Therapy (M.Sc. in Occupational Therapy / M.OT) from a recognised university; 3 years teaching experience in the concerned speciality; Knowledge of Konkani Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi Pay Scale: Pay Matrix Level-11 | Age Limit: Not exceeding 45 years Essential Qualification (any one of the following): Post Graduate in Clinical Embryology (minimum four semesters, full-time) with an additional 3 years of human Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) laboratory experience, OR Ph.D. (full-time, project related to Clinical Embryology/ART/Fertility) with 1 additional year of human ART laboratory experience, OR MBBS/BVSc with a PG degree in Clinical Embryology (full-time) plus 2 years of ART laboratory experience, OR PG in Life Sciences or Biotechnology with 1 year of on-site full-time Clinical Embryology certified training, plus 4 years of experience in an ART Level 2 clinic Knowledge of Konkani is essential Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi Pay Scale: Pay Matrix Level-11 | Age Limit: Not exceeding 45 years Essential Qualification: A recognised medical qualification under the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956; a post graduate degree/equivalent in the relevant speciality from an NMC-recognised college; at least one year of teaching or research experience in the super-speciality after obtaining DM/M.Ch. (No experience is required if the DM/M.Ch. is of three years duration); Knowledge of Konkani Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi Pay Scale: Pay Matrix Level-11 | Age Limit: Not exceeding 45 years Essential Qualification: A recognised medical qualification under the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956; a post graduate degree/equivalent in the speciality from an NMC-recognised college; at least three years experience as a lecturer or equivalent teaching post after the PG degree; Knowledge of Konkani Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi Pay Scale: Pay Matrix Level-11 | Age Limit: Not exceeding 45 years Essential Qualification: Recognised Veterinary qualification under the First or Second Schedule to the Indian Veterinary Council Act, 1984, and registration with the Goa State Veterinary Council; Knowledge of Konkani Desirable: Experience in Cattle Development, Poultry Development, or running a Veterinary Dispensary; Knowledge of Marathi Pay Scale: Pay Matrix Level-7

how_to_apply: Visit the official GPSC website at https://gpsc.goa.gov.in or the Government of Goa portal at https://cbes.goa.gov.in/.
Carefully read the "Instructions" available on the Commission's website before filling the application.
Fill in the online application form for the relevant post appropriately.
Pay the application fee online, or generate an e-challan for offline payment at an SBI branch in Goa.
For online payment, download the e-receipt confirming successful payment status.
For offline payment, get the bank stamp on the e-challan and submit it to the Commission's office on or before the last date.
After successful payment, download the completed application form.
Ensure a valid email address and mobile number are entered, as all communication from the Commission will be sent through these.

content_sections.heading: Konkani Language Relaxation Clause
content_sections.text: As per the notification, in case suitable candidates with knowledge of Konkani are not available, the GPSC may recommend a candidate found otherwise fit. This requirement can be relaxed by the Government on the Commission's recommendation, if considered necessary, in the case of Group 'A' posts in Professional Colleges and Consultants in the Directorate of Health Services.

content_sections.heading: GPSC Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The notification states that prescribed Educational Qualifications (EQs) are the minimum requirement, and mere possession of the EQs does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Where the number of applications received is large, the Commission will shortlist candidates to be called for interview, as per the "Instructions" available on the Commission's website. Further details of the selection process (written exam, if any, and interview weightage) are not available in the official notification .

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for GPSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: A specific list of documents to be uploaded/submitted is not available in the official notification . Candidates are advised to refer to the "Instructions" section on the GPSC website before filling out the application, and to keep education certificates, experience certificates, and identity proof ready in general practice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GPSC Advt No. 08/2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official GPSC website at https://gpsc.goa.gov.in or the Government of Goa portal at https://cbes.goa.gov.in/ . Carefully read the "Instructions" available on the Commission's website before filling the application. Fill in the online application form for the relevant post appropriately. Pay the application fee online, or generate an e-challan for offline payment at an SBI branch in Goa. For online payment, download the e-receipt confirming successful payment status. For offline payment, get the bank stamp on the e-challan and submit it to the Commission's office on or before the last date. After successful payment, download the completed application form. Ensure a valid email address and mobile number are entered, as all communication from the Commission will be sent through these.

faq.question: Q1. How many total posts are there in GPSC Advertisement No. 08/2026?
faq.answer: There are 38 posts in total, covering Assistant Professor (various specialities), Embryologist, and Veterinary Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GPSC Advertisement No. 08/2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 28.08.2026 for all posts except the Transfer on Deputation post, and 28.09.2026 for the Transfer on Deputation post (Assistant Professor - Anaesthesiology).

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for GPSC Advt No. 08/2026?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualifications vary by post, but generally include a Master's degree in relevant fields like Occupational Therapy, Clinical Embryology, or a recognized Veterinary qualification. Specific details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these GPSC posts?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through https://gpsc.goa.gov.in or the Government of Goa portal https://cbes.goa.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 45 years for the posts of Assistant Professor (all specialities), Embryologist, and Veterinary Officer. No age limit is specified for the Transfer on Deputation post.

faq.question: Q6. Is knowledge of Konkani mandatory for GPSC posts under this advertisement?
faq.answer: Yes, knowledge of Konkani is listed as an essential qualification for most posts, though this requirement can be relaxed by the Government on the Commission's recommendation for certain Group 'A' posts if suitable candidates with Konkani knowledge are not available.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the GPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the GPSC Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for GPSC Advt No. 08/2026?
faq.answer: The exact application fee amount is not available in the official notification. The notification only describes the online and offline (e-challan/SBI branch) payment procedure.

faq.question: Q9. What is the pay scale for Veterinary Officer in GPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Veterinary Officer post carries Pay Matrix Level-7.

faq.question: Q10. What is the pay scale for Assistant Professor posts in GPSC Advt No. 08/2026?
faq.answer: All Assistant Professor posts and the Embryologist post carry Pay Matrix Level-11.
